alerts.name: High Error Rate
alerts.description: Triggers when error rate exceeds threshold
alerts.search: index=main sourcetype=json source="loan-eligibility-agent" level=ERROR earliest=-15m | stats count as errors | where errors > 10

alerts.name: High Response Time
alerts.description: Triggers when average response time exceeds 5 seconds
alerts.search: index=main sourcetype=json source="loan-eligibility-agent" earliest=-15m | spath event.response_time_ms | stats avg(event.response_time_ms) as avg_time | where avg_time > 5000

alerts.name: High Handoff Rate
alerts.search: index=main sourcetype=json source="loan-eligibility-agent" earliest=-1h | spath event.handoff_reason | stats count(eval(isnotnull('event.handoff_reason'))) as handoffs, count as total | eval rate = (handoffs/total)*100 | where rate > 20

alerts.name: Service Down
alerts.description: Triggers when no events received for 5 minutes
alerts.search: index=main sourcetype=json source="loan-eligibility-agent" earliest=-5m | stats count | where count = 0

alerts.name: Unusual Rejection Rate
alerts.description: Triggers when rejection rate spikes above normal
alerts.search: index=main sourcetype=json source="loan-eligibility-agent" earliest=-1h | spath event.decision | stats count(eval(event.decision="not_eligible")) as rejected, count as total | eval rate = (rejected/total)*100 | where rate > 50
